verdict.rationale: QuickBooks Payroll's own docs say you can customize, run, print, or export a payroll report and share it with an accountant, which covers generating and exporting payroll reports for analysis. The evidence never names payroll registers or gross-to-net reports specifically. Missing for 10: explicit payroll register and gross-to-net report types, export format details (e.g., CSV/Excel), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
